body: ## Summary Diff flame graph tooltips show `NaN%` / `NaNundefined` / bare `undefined` for the Baseline/Comparison/Diff values instead of real numbers, specifically when using **Sandwich view** (Callers/Callees) inside a **Diff flame graph**. Root cause: `mergeSubtrees` and `getParentSubtrees` in `treeTransforms.ts` build new merged nodes for the sandwich view but only recompute `.value`, never `.valueRight`. For diff profiles this leaves `valueRight` `undefined` on every merged sandwich node. `getDiffTooltipData` in `FlameGraphTooltip.tsx` then unconditionally dereferences `item.valueRight!` (non-null assertion), so the arithmetic becomes `NaN` and the unit formatter concatenates the literal string `undefined`. - `mergeSubtrees`: sum `valueRight` across merged items alongside `value`, guarded to only apply when the input carries `valueRight` (diff mode). - `getParentSubtrees`: propagate `valueRight` when rebasing a node onto its child (previously only rebased `.value`). - `getDiffTooltipData`: default a missing `valueRight` to `0` instead of asserting non-null, as defense in depth. Reported in [support-escalations#24150](https://github.com/grafana/support-escalations/issues/24150) and reproduced on play.grafana.org and against a `grafanacloud-ops-profiles` stack. ## Test plan - [x] Added unit tests in `treeTransforms.test.ts` covering `valueRight` summation/propagation in both `mergeSubtrees` and `mergeParentSubtrees`, for diff and non-diff profiles. - [x] Added a regression test in `FlameGraphTooltip.test.tsx` asserting no `NaN`/`undefined` is rendered when `valueRight` is missing on an item. - [x] `yarn jest packages/grafana-flamegraph/src/FlameGraph/treeTransforms.test.ts packages/grafana-flamegraph/src/FlameGraph/FlameGraphTooltip.test.tsx` passes. - [x] Manually verified locally: Explore → TestData → Flame Graph scenario → Diff profile → right-click a node → Sandwich view → hover a node. Tooltip now shows real values instead of `NaN%`/`NaNundefined`/`undefined`. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
title: Flamegraph: Fix NaN/undefined diff tooltip in sandwich view
